memory.summary:
On December 19th, Andy met Noor at the park and discussed various topics including a beautiful sunrise, Andy's sketching, an AI project, and plans for a catch-up at Caroline's Café the next day at 3 PM. Later that day at noon, Andy contacted Leo to collaborate on the AI project and they decided to meet in the park at 1 PM, discussing bringing musical elements into their brainstorming session.

In the evening of December 19th, Andy spoke with Peter at Caroline's Café about the AI project. Both were excited about the progress they had made during the day, and Peter informed Andy that Leo would join them the next day at 3 PM for continued discussions at Caroline's Café. Both agreed to keep the momentum going in their collaboration efforts.

Later on December 19th, Andy spoke with Samantha at the park and they planned to meet at Caroline's Café on Tuesday, December 26th at 3 PM, discussing collaborating on AI projects and possibly having vegan street tacos as suggested by Caroline.

On December 20th, Andy had a conversation with Samantha at her place, planning to continue their discussion about the AI project the next day at 3 PM. He also spoke with Noor at a restaurant where they discussed the AI project, made plans to meet at Caroline's Café on the following day, and agreed to bring snacks for overwhelmed students while collaborating. Additionally, Andy extended an invitation for a double date with Leo and their partners during the vegan street tacos gathering next week.
